caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a light-colored, short-sleeved dress, rendered in fine pencil and light ink on a cream or off-white background. The dress features short sleeves with delicate edging, a gathered neckline, and a fitted waistline. The skirt is wide and flared, adorned with horizontal stripes and a band of floral embroidery or cutwork patterns near the hem. The fabric appears semi-translucent, suggested by the faint, precise lines and shading. The overall color palette consists mainly of soft grays and beiges, with no strong or vivid colors present. The artist’s name, Gladys C. Parker, is lightly inscribed to the lower right of the dress.
title: Child's Dress
